ClampExtension

This limits how far out of clamping bounds we allow the target position to be at most. Effectively, larger values result in bouncier behavior as the scroll boundaries are approached with high velocity.

AvailableContent

Property Value

Content

The content of this container. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children and all methods that mutate osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children (e.g. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Add(`0) and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Remove(`0,System.Boolean)) are forwarded to the content. By default a container's content is itself, in which case osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Container`1.Children refers to osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.CompositeDrawable.InternalChildren. This property is useful for containers that require internal children that should not be exposed to the outside world, e.g. osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1.

Methods

ApplyCurrentToContent()

This is the final internal step of updating the scroll container, which takes osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1.Current and applies it to osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.ScrollContainer`1.ScrollContent in order to correctly offset children.

Overriding this method can be used to inhibit this default behaviour, to for instance redirect the positioning to another container or change the way it is applied.

protected virtual void ApplyCurrentToContent()
